coverage_rule: A line counts as covered only when an old-arm run of a task in its tasks list reached it: the run passed, read the line's file, and, for an ask line, asked a question of the line's category (any question when it is "any"). For other lines the claiming task's check observes the line's gated event or required output, so a passing run is that observation. Claimed lines no run reached, and unclaimed lines, are uncovered.
